title: Actual Source
note:
Actual Source was founded in 2015 by Davis Ngarupe (Cook Islands / USA) and JP Haynie (USA). The studio’s work focuses on strategy, creative direction, and design for visual identities, publications, websites, packaging, apparel, and physical spaces. Recent projects include a visual identity and showroom for French running brand SATISFY, design direction for Atmos Magazine, a book for The Outdoor Recreation Archive, and our ongoing publication and product work with A24.
